description_en: Queries the O&M task configuration of a MongoDB instance
description_zh: 查询MongoDB实例的运维任务配置
name: DescribeActiveOperationMaintenanceConfig

CreatedTime.description_en: The time when the O&M task configuration was created. The time is in the yyyy-mm-ddThh:mm:ssZ format. The time is displayed in UTC
CreatedTime.description_zh: 创建运维任务配置的时间点，格式为yyyy-mm-ddThh:mm:ssZ （utc时间）

CycleTime.description_en:
The cycle time.

If CycleType is set to Month, the return value is a number from 1 to 28, which indicates the day of the month. Multiple values are separated by commas (,).
If CycleType is set to Week, the return value is a number from 1 to 7, which indicates the day of the week. Multiple values are separated by commas (,).

Value format: This field returns a list of numeric serial numbers separated by commas (,), such as "1,2,3", which indicates the execution days of the O&M cycle. It is not a datetime value and does not involve time formats or time zones
CycleTime.description_zh:
周期时间。

当CycleType为Month，返回1～28的数字，表示每月几号，用","拼接。
当CycleType为Week，返回1～7的数字，表示每周星期几，用","拼接。

取值格式：该字段返回以英文逗号分隔的数字序号列表（如"1,2,3"），表示运维周期执行日，不是日期时间值，不涉及时间格式与时区

CycleType.description_en:
The cycle type. Valid values:

Month: Monthly.
Week: Weekly
CycleType.description_zh:
周期类型。

Month 每月
Week 每周

MaintainEndTime.description_en: The end time of the O&M time window. The time is in the hh:mm:ssZ format. The time is displayed in UTC
MaintainEndTime.description_zh: 运维时间窗口结束时间，格式为hh:mm:ssZ (utc时间)

MaintainStartTime.description_en: The start time of the O&M time window. The time is in the hh:mm:ssZ format. The time is displayed in UTC
MaintainStartTime.description_zh: 运维时间窗口开始时间，格式为hh:mm:ssZ (utc时间)

ModifiedTime.description_en: The time when the O&M task configuration was modified. The time is in the yyyy-mm-ddThh:mm:ssZ format. The time is displayed in UTC
ModifiedTime.description_zh: 修改运维任务配置的时间点，格式为yyyy-mm-ddThh:mm:ssZ （utc时间）

Status.description_en:
Indicates whether the configuration is effective. Valid values:

1: Effective.
2: Invalid
Status.description_zh:
配置是否生效。

1 生效
2 无效

HasConfig.description_en:
Indicates whether the O&M task is configured. Valid values:

1: Configured.
0: Not configured
HasConfig.description_zh:
是否已配置：

1：已经配置；
0：未配置
